_readme: All numbers are tunable at runtime: edit this file and restart the app.
The build copies this file next to the executable (build/<config>/config/config.json).
*Progress / *Threshold progress units per second (1.0 == the whole fold)
accelDeviationLimitG   g (the accelerometer natively reports g on Windows)

hingeEstimator._hingeAxis: auto | x | -x | y | -y | z | -z  (explicit values disable auto detection)
hingeEstimator._gyroProgressGain: progress gained per degree of hinge travel; 1/180 = a 180 deg sweep fills the range
hingeEstimator._rateSmoothingTauSeconds: short-term averaging of the rates; separates noise from slow deliberate motion
hingeEstimator._medianFilterLength: odd length; this gyro emits isolated spikes that must be rejected before averaging
_biasLearning: The gyro reports a small offset even when nothing moves.
Bias may ONLY be learned while every axis stays below the rate limit
for at least the delay; the per-axis peak is checked so a slow fold
cannot be absorbed into the offset.
hingeEstimator._stateMachine: thresholds are progress per second (progress gained per second), not deg/s
_idleFreeze: This gyro's X axis has a ~19 deg/s zero-mean noise floor even at rest.
Below the rate floor for longer than the delay, the smoothed rates are
bled to zero so the residue cannot random-walk the progress.
hingeEstimator._motionConfirmRateDegPerSec: spread rotation only counts as whole-device motion above this rate
hingeEstimator._axisEnergyFloor: minimum smoothed energy before an axis may be adopted
hingeEstimator._axisEnergyMinRateDegPerSec: only rates above this feed the axis statistics (must match idleRateFloorDegPerSec)

animation._snapThresholdProgress: jumps larger than this snap instead of sweeping
